name: Gourmet Gateway India Limited
about: Gourmet Gateway India Limited operates in the food and beverage industry in India, Sri Lanka, and Maldives. It operates Asian cuisine restaurants under Kylin and Wanchai brands; coffee stores under Barista Coffee brand; and desserts under Drizzle & Dust brand. The company was formerly known as Intellivate Capital Ventures Limited and changed its name to Gourmet Gateway India Limited in April 2024. Gourmet Gateway India Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Gurugram, India.
